name: Present the first systematic mapping study of Federated

representative_ideas: Present the first systematic mapping study of Federated RAG, synthesizing architectural patterns, challenges, and research trends to provide a unified foundation for future work at the intersection of federated learning and retrieval-augmented generation
common_problems: The emerging field of Federated RAG lacks systematic organization—research is fragmented across privacy-sensitive domains without unified understanding of architectural patterns, design trade-offs, and open challenges
solution_approaches: Conduct a systematic mapping study following Kitchenham's evidence-based software engineering guidelines, classifying literature from 2020-2025 by research focus, contribution types, and application domains; analyze architectural patterns, temporal trends, and key challenges including privacy-preserving retrieval, cross-client heterogeneity, and evaluation limitations
story: Position Federated RAG as the critical intersection enabling secure, knowledge-intensive NLP in privacy-sensitive domains; frame the survey as foundational infrastructure that transforms a rapidly evolving, fragmented research landscape into a structured field with identified design patterns and clear research directions
application: Privacy-sensitive NLP deployments in healthcare, finance, and personalized assistance where models must leverage external knowledge without exposing sensitive data

title: Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Systematic Mapping Study
